name: World Co., Ltd.
summary: World Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, plans, manufactures, retails, sells, and imports/exports apparel and fashion products in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Brand Business, Digital Business, Platform Business, and Common Division segments. It offers women's, men's, and children's clothing and fashion accessories; interior products; jewelry and fashion goods; and men's and women's golf apparel products under the adabat brand.
